## Professional Summary
Ronald Allan Rivera is a versatile full-stack developer who builds high-performance web applications, SaaS platforms, AI automation systems, and WordPress solutions. With expertise spanning Python, Laravel, PHP, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, and modern DevOps practices, he delivers scalable, production-ready solutions for businesses and startups.

## Core Skills & Technologies
- **Backend**: Python (Django, Flask), Laravel, PHP, Node.js
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, Vue.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **WordPress**: Custom plugin development, theme customization, WooCommerce
- **AI & Automation**: OpenAI API integration, workflow automation, data processing
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Docker, AWS, Vercel, CI/CD, database optimization
- **SaaS Development**: Multi-tenant architecture, payment integration, API design
